edits.new:
### 12. Contract

Contract baseline (D-RCV-60). The placement operation POST /queues/{queueId}/placements is provided on the rwb-integration base with the four legacy body fields (caseId, reason, modelOrAgent, version), a required Idempotency-Key and the 201 answer of the legacy story. The case-base placement is consumed and owned by P3. The JSON element names of the consumed contracts are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0671) until their owners publish them. The 24-hour replay window is the platform rule. A refusal carries one of RIGHT_NOT_HELD, CALLER_KIND or SCOPE_NOT_ALL with 403 and MSG-P4-002. The 422 and 503 codes keep MSG-GEN-001, MSG-GEN-002 and MSG-P7-003, and their code names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0958). A non-human caller is admitted on scope ALL only; any other scope is refused with SCOPE_NOT_ALL. The presented queue team code is recorded and compared with nothing. The caller code and type are recorded and not resolved to a role. The subject resolves through the role of the service identity at the matrix version in force, with the class check NON_HUMAN_ACTOR. The deviation hold is carried on DeviationRaised (EV-06) and DeviationCleared (EV-07); their element names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3102). The approved callers list, the matrix version, the overflow answer shape, the caller mapping, the login name and the legacy criteria are configuration, contract or deployment values held in the places named by GAP-0735, not in this story.
